description: RETFound-MAE fine-tuned on the PAPILA dataset for 3-class glaucoma classification (normal, glaucoma suspect, glaucoma) from a color fundus photograph, with ViT Grad-CAM visualization (research/non-commercial use only). Validated to never top-rank the Glaucoma class in local testing (class-imbalance calibration effect, confirmed correct class order) -- interpret the returned per-class probabilities as a relative risk signal rather than relying on the single top-1 label.
disease: glaucoma, glaucoma suspect, optic nerve disease
